d.ctx: The user asks about moving to WhatsApp. The expert responds by saying let's talk here first.
d.j: Proposing to move to a named external app.

d.tr: If you want to remove the saree, you have to do it on WhatsApp.
d.ctx: The expert suggests removing clothes on WhatsApp. The user responds by asking about the expert's age.
d.j: Offering to show the body or undress on an external app.

d.seg: ఆరు రెండు ఒక నిమిషం... ఆరు ఎనిమిది ఒకటి ఎనిమిది ఒకటి... ఐదు ఐదు తొమ్మిది తొమ్మిది తొమ్మిది తొమ్మిది ఆరు ఒకటి
d.ctx: The expert provides a phone number. The user says they will type it down.
d.j: Giving a phone number for external contact.

d.tr: I will message you right now.
d.ctx: The user confirms they will message the expert on the provided number. The expert agrees.
d.j: Proposing to continue contact outside the app via messaging.

d.seg: నిన్ను చూస్తే నాకు మంట లేచింది అందుకే మాట్లాడదామని
d.tr: Seeing you makes me feel hot/aroused, that's why I wanted to talk.
d.ctx: The user expresses sexual arousal towards the expert. The expert responds by telling them to call.
d.j: Sexual talk directed at the other person.
